ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:9 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark-charcoal pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark grey/black substrate with high-contrast white circular blobs (rosettes) distributed across both lobes. Concentrations of white pixels are highest at the distal tips and in clustered annular formations on the central-right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a pixel angle of approximately 75 degrees and a vertical depth roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated trailing edge with high-frequency variations (2-5 pixel amplitude). Notable jagged irregularity and tissue recession at the terminal tip of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave sweep from the median notch extending to pointed distal tips, following a roughly parabolic curve on each lobe's trailing boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive detection of roughly circular and ring-shaped high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) across both lobes, varying in diameter from 5 to 25 pixels.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single distinct horizontal white linear disruption (approx. 25 pixels in length) visible in the medial region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive permanent scarring from historic barnacle colonization (circular rosettes); significant irregular tissue loss at the left lobe distal extremity.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique triplet of adjacent ring-shaped scars forming a small cluster in the upper-medial quadrant of the right lobe.
